Why free, and what happens later

CAtool is built by a practising CA and is still early. While we grow, it's free for everyone — that's the fairest way to earn a place in your practice. We may introduce sensible paid plans down the line, once the tools have clearly proven their worth. If we do, we'll give plenty of notice, and anything you've already downloaded stays usable.

Frequently asked

Is it really free? What's the catch?

No catch. CAtool is completely free during early access — no card at install, no auto-debit, no subscription. There's simply nothing to pay today.

Will it always be free?

We may introduce fair paid plans later, once the tools have matured and proven their value. We'll announce it well in advance — and whatever you've installed will keep working.

Can my whole office use it?

Yes. Install it on as many office PCs as you like during early access — there's no seat count or licence to manage.

What if the IT portal changes and the tool breaks?

It will happen. When it does, we ship an update within a few days and your installed app auto-updates — no reinstall needed.

Do you store our clients' PAN passwords on your server?

No. Passwords are encrypted with Windows DPAPI and never leave your PC. Nothing about your clients is uploaded to us.
